name: 波波螺
evolution: 波波螺 → 消波螺 Lv.16 → 嗜波螺 Lv.32
description: 经常频繁抖动身体，推测是缓解外壳生长带来的不适感。它们常集体排成一列迎向海浪，借助外壳的结构消解冲击。浪头拍来时会张口吸入送上门的食物，连很硬的东西也能消化。
descriptionEn: It frequently shakes its body, which is presumed to relieve the discomfort caused by the growth of its shell. They often line up in a group to face the waves, using the structure of their shells to dissipate the impact. When a wave breaks over them they open their mouths and suck in the food delivered to them, and can even digest very hard things.
